title: ArchitectureExtractionOutput
description: Structured output for the LLM's ONLY job at this stage: turn uploaded intake material into candidate Authority Map nodes and edges. This schema has no field for evidence_level above E1 and no field for asserting a control is adequate, by design, so the model has no way to overreach even if prompted to.

temp_id.description: Local reference id for use in edges below, not a database id

source_excerpt.description: The exact text this node was extracted from, required for traceability

requires_human_approval.description: null if the source material does not say, never default to false

extraction_confidence.description: The model's confidence in the extraction ITSELF, not in the system's security. Never omit.

unresolved_questions.description: Explicit list of what the source material did not answer. An empty array must be a deliberate claim, not an omission.

contradictions.description: Explicit source-material contradictions found during extraction.
